items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Louie Metcalf was up there playing, so I walked in, and man, Louie Metcalf, Herman Autrey

ctx.x: No, Sandy was gone. So oh, I got to mention my man. He was sitting there playing the trumpet, who was very good now, lives in Long Island now. He was on First Avenue there for a long time, with his own band, you know. (Snaps fingers.) Metcalf.
